svg.title: UML class diagram of NEMOS_MeshAnalysis.py
svg.text: Quality of the mesh OpenFOAM actually solved on: cell-quality metrics and the near-wall growth rate, read from the finished case with PyVista.
no public set_time(): pick the time here
2nd / 1st cell thickness along each wall normal (cKDTree)
Not the same check as Mesh.check_quality() in GeoMesh.py: that one
runs inside SALOME, on the SALOME mesh, with SMESH filters. This
module reads the converted mesh from the case.
